name: DataForSEO
description: DataForSEO lets agents read search results, keyword volumes, backlinks, rankings and on-page data. Each user signs in to their own DataForSEO account through the browser, and each request is paid from that account's balance.

prompts.text: What is the monthly search volume for these keywords in the US?
Who ranks in the top ten on Google for this query?
Summarize the backlink profile of this domain.

apps.name: DataForSEO
apps.description: Search results, keywords, backlinks, and rankings, over DataForSEO's MCP server with browser sign-in.
